hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; [ -t 0 ] || event=$(cat); build=$(cargo build --quiet --all-targets </dev/null 2>&1) || { printf 'detent: the tree does not build, so no gate ran:
%s
' "$build" >&2; case "$(printf '%s' "$event" | tr -d ' 
')" in *'"stop_hook_active":true'*) echo 'detent: not blocking a second time; the build failure stands and CI will refuse it.' >&2; exit 1;; esac; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$event" | cargo run --quiet -- gate --hook --changed
